content: Budgets are near-universal in category leaders: Money Manager markets 'advanced budget feature, monthly budget per category'; Spendee markets smart budgets as a core step; YNAB is budget-first (envelope method); Bluecoins has budgets. However, budget apps (YNAB) and expense loggers (Money Manager) are distinct sub-categories; simple loggers can omit budgets. For a personal logger, budgets are a v1.x differentiator, not a v1 floor — but the market clearly treats budgets as expected for 'expense & budget' positioning.
